AniLumos stable release trigger
Version v1.0.2
Update: you can now update directly from the app.
Publish only after the reviewed direct-update hotfix merges into main.
Require tests, lint, signed universal mobile APK, OAuth configuration,
package version 1.0.2 (versionCode 9), zip alignment and certificate verification.
The installer verifies package identity, published APK checksum and trusted signer.
Do not overwrite v1.0.1; publish v1.0.2 as an in-place upgrade.
